pool_classes.TRAIN_TUNING: Reusable development evidence. Never eligible for G1, G8 or Goal-2 promotion.
pool_classes.CALIBRATION: May tune thresholds, variance, MDE/power, estimator or mechanism qualification. Never eligible for G1, G8 or Goal-2 promotion.
pool_classes.G1_PROSPECTIVE: Fresh sealed one-generation parent-vs-candidate pool. Consumed after use; no tuning.
pool_classes.G8_CASCADE: Fresh sealed final Goal-1 cascade pool. Never used for tuning, relation selection or prior choice.
pool_classes.GOAL2_E5B: Fresh pool disjoint from Goal-1 tuning and lineage development; same-start improver comparison only.
pool_classes.RESEARCH_FROZEN: Future capability/research pool; no use until exact lane/verifier/budget/contamination contract is frozen.

reuse_rule: A suite/task instance ever used for TRAIN_TUNING or CALIBRATION cannot later be relabeled G1_PROSPECTIVE, G8_CASCADE, GOAL2_E5B or RESEARCH_FROZEN promotion evidence.

MM-ORACLE-PHASE1-REACT.reason: Existing active Mastermind oracle/diagnostic suite; may qualify mechanisms but cannot be recycled as Supernova G1/G8/Goal2 evidence.

MM-DESIGN2CODE-HARD-STATEFUL.reason: Named successor is part of Mastermind development/generalization programme; reserve separate fresh Supernova pools.

MM-LIVEEVAL-L3.reason: Development/generalization lane; live naming alone does not make it a sealed Supernova promotion pool.

MF-E1-CLEAN-ROUTE-TRUTH.reason: E1 measures route/schedule headroom before G1; it may determine design but cannot itself be G1/G8 promotion evidence.

MF-G1-CLEAN-PROSPECTIVE.reason: Reserved one-generation fresh parent-vs-candidate capability gate. Exact task instances remain sealed until private freeze.

MF-C1-PRODUCT-CLOSURE.reason: Component closure experiment; results may qualify C1 but final G8 uses a disjoint pool.

MF-E3-MECHANISM-CONTROL.reason: Component mechanism experiment; not G8 evidence.

MF-E5-MULTIGEN.reason: Optional post-Goal1 multi-generation development; not the Goal-2 same-start improver test.

MF-E5B-IMPROVER.reason: Reserved Goal-2 same-start matched-budget improver-of-improver evaluation; opens only after Goal1 G8 pass.

MF-E6-INDEPENDENT.reason: Future independent capability lane requires its own exact contract before admission.

G8_CASCADE.required_action: Create a disjoint fresh G8 pool and problem-by-relation eligibility registry before final Goal-1 freeze.

RESEARCH_FROZEN.required_action: Create only after capability-lane contract is accepted.

fresh0_consequence: FRESH-0 remains OPEN until sealed G1/G8/Goal2 pools and the problem x relation eligibility matrix establish relation-level coverage without exposing outcomes.
